checks.command:
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-council-gate.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); printf 'author: worker
judge: judge-a
judge_program: codex
judge_model_family: gpt
context_id: ctx-a
VERDICT: PASS
COMMANDS RUN:
  go test ./...
' >"$tmp/a"; printf 'author: worker
judge: judge-b
judge_program: codex
judge_model_family: gpt
context_id: ctx-b
VERDICT: PASS
COMMANDS RUN:
  go test ./...
' >"$tmp/b"; sed 's/VERDICT: PASS/VERDICT: FAIL/' "$tmp/b" >"$tmp/fail"; sed '/COMMANDS RUN:/,$d' "$tmp/b" >"$tmp/unverified"; "$tmp/ao" council-gate "$tmp/a" "$tmp/b" >"$tmp/pass.out"; grep -qx 'COUNCIL PASS: 2/2 judges unanimous across 2 distinct contexts (1 model families)' "$tmp/pass.out"; set +e; "$tmp/ao" council-gate "$tmp/a" "$tmp/fail" >"$tmp/mixed.out" 2>"$tmp/mixed.err"; mixed=$?; "$tmp/ao" council-gate "$tmp/a" "$tmp/unverified" >"$tmp/unverified.out" 2>"$tmp/unverified.err"; unverified=$?; "$tmp/ao" council-gate "$tmp/a" >"$tmp/args.out" 2>"$tmp/args.err"; args=$?; set -e; test "$mixed" -eq 8; test "$unverified" -eq 6; test "$args" -eq 1; grep -qx 'DISAGREEMENT: 1 PASS / 1 FAIL - fail-closed; dispatch tie-break' "$tmp/mixed.err"; grep -q 'verdict(s) unverified' "$tmp/unverified.err"; grep -qx 'Error: requires at least 2 arg(s), only received 1' "$tmp/args.err"

aliases.reason: The council-gate command declares no aliases.

tracker_selection.reason: Council verdict aggregation does not select an issue tracker.
